title: Juuha Shou
body:
Syntax: perform juuha shou <target>

Description: A slicing Wind attack that can knock a target off balance.  Requires Wind chakra nature. Base damage: 62-71. 25% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 30. Costs 28 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
